name: bt_queue_external

ownership.argument: Cross-task external ring retains argument for run/cancel; it does not free argument. Uninitialized queue calls cancel(0,221,argument) synchronously. Return is unlock semaphore result or cancel result, not acceptance status.

provenance.source: Exact-image external-ring producer0x0C98FDD0 and consumer0x0C98FBE0; locked publication and wake on empty-to-nonempty transition. Replaces owner-only internal insertion0x0C98FD8C.

notes: Five arguments retain the existing order and final event byte1. Veneer0x1C167D40 ->0x0C98FDD0 locks/publishes the external ring and posts Bluelet semaphore0x3C492750 when needed. Old0x1C1676C8 ->0x0C98FD8C is owner-only list insertion without wake. May block; not an interrupt-context API. Restricted/PENDING, no runtime approval.
